allow: Auto-approve `git push` (including `git push origin main`, `git push -u origin main`, `gp`, `gpsup`, and `git -C <path> push ...`) targeting the `main` or `master` branch on the user's personal repositories. Detect 'personal repository' by the `origin` remote URL matching `github.com[:/]rvadaga/` — these are owned solely by the user. The user is the sole maintainer of personal repos and prefers direct push to main over PR review; do NOT block such pushes citing 'bypasses PR review'. Force-push variants (`--force`, `--force-with-lease`, `-f`) are already on the permissions `ask` list and still require explicit user authorization. This rule does NOT apply to (a) repos under `github.com/etsy/` or any organization owner, (b) forks of upstream projects (detect: `origin` and `upstream` remotes diverge), (c) any repo where branch protection or CODEOWNERS implies review is expected.

Auto-approve `darwin-rebuild switch --flake <path> --override-input personal-config github:rvadaga/<repo>/<branch>` (and the `esudo`-prefixed form) when the override target is a `github:rvadaga/*` branch (the user's own personal-config repo). This is the documented local-testing workflow for personal-config `.nix` changes before they merge to main — see `dotfiles/claude/skills/nix-rebuild/SKILL.md` ('only use `--override-input` for significant `*.nix` file changes that warrant local testing before pushing'). The override target is the user's own unreviewed code; same trust level as their committed config. Do NOT block citing 'unmerged feature branch', 'unauthorized rebuild', or 'applying unreviewed code system-wide' — that IS the workflow. For `--override-input` pointing at non-`rvadaga/*` sources, apply normal classifier judgment.

hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])(git[[:space:]]+push|gp|ggpush|gpsup|gpsupf|gpf|gpd|gpv|gpu|gpoat|gpod)([^a-zA-Z0-9_-]|$)'; then branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ] && printf '%s' "$branch" | grep -qE '^(rahul/)?[a-z]+-[a-z]+-[a-f0-9]{6}$'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"refusing to push: current branch matches claude-auto-generated name pattern (two-word + 6-hex-suffix). rename it first via /wt-name (per CLAUDE.md branch naming rule)."}}'; fi; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(--no-gpg-sign|commit[.]gpgsign=(false|no|off|0))'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"refusing: commit signing is on by default (commit.gpgsign=true, signing key registered on github) so commits are auto-verified. do not disable it with --no-gpg-sign or commit.gpgsign=false; remove the flag and commit normally."}}'; fi
git worktree prune 2>/dev/null; git branch --list 'worktree-*' | while read b; do git branch -d "$b" 2>/dev/null; done
